_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Use when designing tests that verify the interaction between two or more units of a system — modules, services,…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "design an integration test for the order service that exercises real database and real message bus"
cases.context: The agent has access to the integration-test-design skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is integration-test-design the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes integration-test-design as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against test-driven-development, testing-strategy, test-doubles-design
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the integration-test-design workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore integration-test-design
Does not route to test-driven-development, testing-strategy, test-doubles-design when the integration-test-design scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
